data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at the start of 2020 were $140.676m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $11.224m (7.98% of opening reserves), driven principally by deterioration on older underwriting years largely associated with quota-share treaty underperformance (AXA/XL), natural catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Michael and Typhoon Hagibis) and a material casualty large loss (NiSource gas explosion). The movement reflects strengthening of reserves overall across the reinsurance/treaty portfolio and selected casualty exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: In addition the 2018 Account suffered a prior year adverse movement of 2.2% points from the 2017 Account AXA/XL Whole Account Quota Share contract.

The AxaXL cession was also renewed but with a reduced line applied evenly across the AxaXL group so that the quota share was weighted towards Axa XL's non-Lloyd's business and at 36% represented a much smaller share of the Syndicate's premium than the 100% of the year before.
The only significant loss event to the diversified portfolio is Hurricane Michael which has triggered a recovery from our reinsurance protection.

On the Casualty QS Portfolio, the Syndicate was exposed to the NiSource Massachusetts Gas Explosion where the there was a total limits loss of $800 Million, of which Syndicate 2689's share is $5.3 Million.
The 2019 Year of Account has unfortunately suffered a material loss from Typhoon Hagibis
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was not stated as a single gross figure in narrative or a 'movement in prior year provision' gross line. PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019 and 2020) per methodology guidance. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from $'000 to millions. The report contains narrative references to net prior-year movements (percentages) and to underperforming quota-share (AXA/XL) but no single explicit gross PYD number; the triangle-derived PYD is therefore used (confidence 0.8).
